summary.title: More cards in hand: steady draw, wheel reach and mana into cards
summary.blurb: Opened to experiment with pure card draw, tutors that reach a wheel and a way to turn spare mana into cards, because the deck runs out of cards while its engine floods with mana. Nothing is staged yet.
